tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thanks for participating in the study.I'd like to ask you some questions about your experiences with home decoration. First, do you enjoy decorating your living space or do you find it challenge? Why do you think that is?
tasks.sample: I really enjoy decorating my living space. It’s a fun creative activity for me. I love picking out small decorations and rearranging furniture to make the room look nicer. Besides, doing this helps me make my place feel more personal and cozy. I never feel stressed about it, so it’s always an enjoyable thing to do in my free time.
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢你参与这项研究。我想问你一些关于你家居装修经历的问题。首先，你是否喜欢对居住空间进行装饰，还是觉得这颇具挑战性？你为什么会这么认为呢？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting, thank you. Can you describe a recent home decoration project you all worked on and what changes were made?
tasks.sample: Not long ago, I redecorated my bedroom. First, I changed the old curtains to soft light-colored ones. I also added some potted plants and warm table lamps around the room. I even rearranged my desk to get more natural light. These small changes didn’t cost much, but the whole room felt brighter and more pleasant right away.
tasks.analysis: 中文：挺有趣的，谢谢。你能描述一下你们最近一起完成的一项家居装饰项目吗？都做了哪些改动呢？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Okay, what kinds of living spaces do you find inviting or comfortable? Why do you think that is?
tasks.sample: I prefer simple and bright living spaces the most. Rooms with large windows and plenty of natural light always make me feel relaxed. Also, I like places with warm-colored walls and soft furniture. They create a calm atmosphere. On the contrary, dark and crowded rooms make me feel tired and uneasy. That’s why bright, tidy spaces suit me best.
tasks.analysis: 中文：好的，你觉得哪些类型的居住空间是让人感到吸引或舒适的呢？你为什么会这么认为呢？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Some people believe that a well decorated living space can significantly improve one's mood and productivity. Do you agree or disagree with this viewpoint, or why not?
tasks.sample: I totally agree with this idea. A neat and nicely decorated room puts people in a good mood right away. When I stay in a pleasant space, I feel less anxious and more focused. For study or work, a comfortable environment helps me stay efficient. In contrast, a messy or dull room easily distracts me and makes me unwilling to get things done.
tasks.analysis: 中文：有些人认为，一个精心布置的居住空间能够极大地改善人的心情和工作效率。你是否认同这一观点呢？
tasks.title: Interview
